sermon.title: Masquerade
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that a mask doesn’t change who you are. Satan masquerades as an angel of light, and his ministers as ministers of righteousness. He shows predators hiding as teachers, clergy, parents and police, baptized leaders who wore masks, and Jefferson’s warning that God’s justice won’t sleep forever. Jesus said we will know them by their fruits, and he will protect children.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: 1 John 1:5 spoken as “John 15”; Jefferson quote paraphrased (“I fear for my nation”); Stalin’s death toll garbled; Clinton founding a new Baptist church; Trump led to Christ by Paula White; Jefferson fighting slavery in the Constitution; Trinity described as “God in the flesh and God in light”; returning body “has no blood”. UNVERIFIED statistics: 1.6 million runaway/throwaway kids yearly; over 4 million public school students molested; abuse sentences cited. Sensitive content kept as spoken: on-screen child abuse cases (teacher, priest, youth pastor, father, mother, policeman, soldiers) with garbled private names marked [unclear]; dressing as a woman doesn’t make one a woman; mother selling food stamps; government rewarding bad behavior; judicial system “corrupt and evil”; Trump womanizing.

faqs.question: Can the dead harm the living?
faqs.answer: He says the dead can do nothing.

faqs.question: Does Satan have horns and a pitchfork?
faqs.answer: No, that is an artist’s idea.

faqs.question: Can you judge a person by appearance?
faqs.answer: No, look at their actions and speech.

faqs.question: Can Clinton and Trump be forgiven?
faqs.answer: Yes, if they admit the wrong and turn.

faqs.question: How do you recognize false prophets?
Who is a child’s first line of defense?
faqs.answer: The parent; then the church; then government.

faqs.question: How does Jesus come the second time?
faqs.answer: As a lion to judge, not a lamb to save.
